description: Repositories used to build the ExplainHub documentation-enhancer dataset. split=train rows are trained on; split=eval rows are held out and must never appear in train.jsonl; split=ignore repos are skipped. The raw/ snapshots under datasets/pairs/<id>/ are the source of truth: refresh them explicitly, then correct them by hand.

repos.note: Hand-written sample pair committed with the project. Used to regenerate data/example.jsonl.
ExplainHub itself. Run --refresh-raw once, then copy raw/ to corrected/ and edit the prose.
Held-out React Native/Expo app. Never trained on; used by scripts/evaluate. Clone with: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tadeolmd-ubu/Loteria-mexicana.git training/repos/loteria-mexicana
